reading.body:
Gregory Meeks's AI record is mostly money: 11 of 18 dated events are political committee contributions from Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and Anthropic, totaling $21,000.

The contributions run from March 2025 to June 2026 and come from the political committees of five of the largest AI and cloud companies. Amazon appears four times, Meta three, Google and Microsoft twice each, Anthropic once. The amounts are small and repeated rather than large and singular, which is the pattern of routine committee giving rather than a single decisive donation.

The legislative side is thinner and harder to read. Meeks sponsored the RESTRICT Act, which the data describes as covering export and security trade restrictions for integrated circuit technologies, and cosponsored the AI OVERWATCH Act on export oversight and weaponizable technology. Both are dated 2025-12-18, which the data says is the bill's latest status date rather than the date of the action. Four recorded votes appear, all yea, on bills the data does not describe.

What this does not show is causation or intent. Contributions and votes are listed in date order, and the data explicitly states that placement is not a claim that one event caused another. The vote entries name bill numbers without saying what the bills do, so a reader cannot tell whether any vote touched the same subject as the contributions. The data also covers only what this site holds for one member, not the full record, and it says nothing about data centers, power, or compute directly. The connection to AI scaling here is indirect: the companies giving are the ones building and financing the compute, and their committees are the visible edge of that interest in Congress.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for Gregory Meeks: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 18 events.
